correctness.rationale: Exact 12-vertex graph enumeration yields 863 simplices and 428 matched pairs; complete directed Hasse sort verifies all 3432 incidences are acyclic. One critical 0-cell and three each of critical 3- and 4-cells remain, with identically zero exact integral Morse boundary. Hurewicz identifies all 4-cell attaching classes with the zero degree vectors, proving the sphere wedge. Exact gradient cycle representatives yield 24 homology action matrices satisfying all 1152 composition checks, giving characters (3,-1,3,0,-1) and (3,-1,-1,0,1). Mod-two ranks independently corroborate Betti groups.

value.rationale: This determines the exact integral homotopy type and separate nontrivial S4 homology representations for a canonical vertex-transitive Archimedean graph. The nonpure six-vertex-face complex unexpectedly has homology in two adjacent high degrees, and representation theory distinguishes 1+2 and 3 dimensional modules that Betti numbers cannot resolve. The graph/invariant pair has independent mathematical motivation from higher independence complexes and Platonic truncation, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
